style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

⟦0⟧ is one of the few countries that starts without a military force.
The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

In a starting scenario Iceland is a sole Danish dominion. An isolated island away from Europe, with one civilian and navy industry, that cant stand against on its own against the powerful marine neighbours, unless if it mobilizes or turns to radical focuses. It would be preferable to become Fascist, albeit joining Germany's faction or being communist and joining up the Soviets. Alternatively, staying Democratic or taking the Non Aligned government doesn't hold up for an active war campaign, to which it will last a peaceful gameplay.

Depending on how the events play out, the main priority is to expand and reassert itself in the face of the globe, and then it is depending on the player if it wishes to proceeds for additional conquest.

To Start off as Iceland, it is better off to get rid of the King Christian X of Denmark, in order to make way for independence. Depending on which ideology, either fascist or communist, it is best to boost it up with a political advisor in order to get it to the right percentage of support and to unlock the focuses that lie ahead. As you get enough support the focus "Break the Crown" can be taken, and Denmark in this case will usually accept the Icelandic independence prompting so for Iceland to focus on the awaiting conquest, once again. In meantime research on Industrial and Engineering technology for a balanced research speed to balance the deficit speed that Iceland has. Manpower is already an issue, hire the Progressive Doctor for the weekly manpower as you will build up an army soon enough, and it wont be locked from the conscription laws. Supply lines and Support will play a crucial role in following campaign, as you have to research Trains and Artillery to put up with supply lines and combat performance.

If Iceland has chosen to become Fascist, it is best to generate some Army Experience for "State serves the Military" Spirit, for additional political power and lesser conscription laws. After completing State Visits as Fascist Iceland, it is best to appoint German Consul as an advisor, to generate more manpower, and in this case 150 weekly manpower, and extra research speed that will come handy. Rush the International Trade Focus to remove the Isolation economy and disarmed nation, and gain one extra military factory and an improved agency, and as well as decreased consumer good factories. Afterwards, generate a slight tension by justifying randomly on China. Justify and cancel, only to get enough tension to join the Axis. Make sure to purchase weapons such as artillery or just civilian supplies, as waiting to have more than one military factory will certainly take some time. Finish up the Viking Spirits Focus and it grants a decision list that boosts your newly gained national spirit which if having enough political power it is better to invest time to time. Start up producing 5 infantry units when manpower builds up sufficiently enough. If given time, license produce a Submarine from Germany to have an early navy to help your army for potential invading targets.

Iceland as a one core state, isn't going to rely on advisors forever. The last of the 3 focuses in the fascist tree consists of taking Greenland, Faroes, Jan Mayen, and Shetland from Denmark, Norway and the UK. Although it has a rolling chance, Denmark is likely to cede Greenland to Iceland if the latter is in a mighty faction. In this case it is the Axis, to which Iceland finally cores Greenland and the chances for factory expansions and building opens up properly. Greenland has 14 Aluminium resources, which in a way will benefit for trading. Next you justify on the Dutch East Indies, in order to get to the Netherlands and using their lands as naval invading bases to soon invade the UK. Declare war on them, and immediately land on the Netherlands. Annex them, and puppet the East Indies and take their navy. Keeping East Indies as a puppet state for manpower, will prove impactful. Thus the Icelandic manpower will concern itself for Garrison troops in occupations. Immediately justify and declare war on Denmark next, and they will surrender instantly and eventually become your puppet.

To rise up the tensions, try to justify and cancel justifications on US or any other major democratic nations except France. Britain would be diverted and guaranteeing independence on these nations before your real target. Gather your puppet nations troops and place them in the Belgian border, and justify on them. The justification will last 10 days, and Belgium will be already guaranteed by France and Britain. Divide your troops, one for the invasion of Belgium and one for the naval invasion of Britain. Be sure to call Germany into your faction, because handling it alone wont last long. France will surely capitulate, as the German aid will put down any significant defence they will lay onto. Focus, on the British Campaign, and seize as much territory as you can, bypassing some of the British defences. Ironically, if having enough supremacy over the British Isles, and finishing the land claim focus for Faores, Jan Mayen and Shetland will make Britain cede land along with Denmark. With a notable exception of Norway that stands defiant. While Iceland is fighting the British, justify on Finland, Sweden and Norway in order to get them to join the Allies, for more land gain, if the Axis win. The Icelandic troops at this point should all be in the British isles pushing the remnants of the British troops up north in Scotland. Outflank the troops, as the British troops are in a disarray, and push them until they finally capitulate. Annex Britain, Norway, Sweden, Canada, France(for the St Pierre land near Newfoundland)

Should the Soviet pressure to surrender Karjala to them come to pass, go for the annexing decision that Iceland gets for puppeting Denmark. Follow the decisions that make Denmark quick to be annexed, or do it manually, and form the Nordic League.
